summary: Full regression retest per briefing. Backend pytest suite: 6 cases pass (4 pre-existing signup/design-kit tests + 2 new design-kit CONTENT tests I added for the refreshed criterion). Re-ran all 26 pre-existing named browser checks from iteration_5/6 plus the auth-entry-signed-in check (which needed a fresh Clerk sign-in ticket -- the saved one had expired; regenerated via Clerk backend API /v1/sign_in_tokens for jane+clerk_test@example.com and updated the check in place, then it passed: sign-in/sign-up pages render, nav-user-menu appears after ticket redirect). marketplace-usp-section re-ran clean with no console errors (covers the 4-bar/unique-key fix implicitly -- no React key warnings observed). quick-links-highlight-own-card failed once on a navigation timeout (dev-server hiccup, unrelated to app code) and passed clean on immediate rerun -- classified flaky, not a bug. All other 25 checks passed on first try. 0 bugs found.

action_items.detail: quick-links-highlight-own-card failed once on a page.goto navigation timeout then passed clean on immediate rerun -- classified as flaky (dev-server/network hiccup), not an app bug. No action needed unless it recurs.

The auth-entry-signed-in check's persisted Clerk sign-in ticket had expired since iteration_5; regenerated a new one via Clerk's backend API and updated the check script in place so it stays valid for roughly another hour from this run. Future retests more than ~1h after this one will need another regeneration (POST https://api.clerk.com/v1/sign_in_tokens with the test user's Clerk user_id, documented in this run).

Design kit's brand-logo folder is named assets/brand-logos/ rather than the briefing's literal 'assets/brands' wording -- functionally equivalent (contains the 6 expected brand SVGs: grok, siri, meta-ai, copilot, gemini, chatgpt, claude), treated as a wording difference, not a bug.
